description: This is a Java class named ClientChargeRepositoryWrapper that acts as a wrapper around the ClientChargeRepository, providing methods to find, save, and delete ClientCharge entities, with enrichment of currency details from OrganisationCurrencyRepositoryWrapper.

classes.name: ClientChargeRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring Service class that wraps around ClientChargeRepository to provide additional logic such as currency enrichment and exception handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a ClientCharge by ID and enriches it with currency info; throws ChargeNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves the ClientCharge and immediately flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the given ClientCharge entity and flushes the repository.
